changelog: v18.12.96: Implemented strict linear room progression and final dialogue transition in HiddenObject_Minigame.cs — Room 1 (Shop) is unlocked initially and locks upon completion while unlocking Room 2 (House); Room 2 locks upon completion while unlocking Room 3 (Market); completing Room 3 triggers the claim reward flow and transitions directly into the Cat Dialogue announcing the upcoming Cauldron Defense minigame.

v18.12.95: Fixed post-victory progression flow in HiddenObject_Minigame.cs — clicking Claim Rewards now returns the player to the Room Selection screen with unlocked subsequent rooms, status badges, and updated lock overlays instead of triggering premature Cauldron Defense dialogue transitions.

v18.12.94: Completely removed Unicode emoji characters (money bag, diamond, scroll, test tubes, sparkles) from Victory_Rewards_Text and Record mode victories in HiddenObject_Minigame.cs, eliminating all LiberationSans SDF square placeholder warnings.

v18.12.93: Fixed InvalidOperationException in HiddenObject_Minigame.cs by providing unified support for new Input System (Mouse.current.scroll) and legacy Input Manager. Removed all Unicode emoji characters causing LiberationSans SDF font warnings.

v18.12.92: Fixed CatchMouse_Game_Panel remaining visible when transitioning to Hidden Object via F9. Enforced mutual exclusivity of minigame panels in OpenMinigame and CloseMinigame. Updated 3 room buttons hierarchy guide and full screen background stretch setup.

v18.12.91: Merged duplicate Update() in AlchemyFishing_Minigame.cs resolving CS0111 compilation error. Replaced Unicode lock emoji with standard text in HiddenObject_Minigame.cs fixing LiberationSans SDF font character missing warning. Added Leonardo AI full-screen 16:9 prompt and step-by-step custom button branding guide.

v18.12.90: Implemented chained F9 minigame skip — pressing F9 the first time skips Catch Mouse and launches Fishing dialogue; pressing F9 again (or during Fishing) instantly wins Alchemy Fishing (+3000 Gold, +3 Stones, +1 Scroll, +100 XP) and transitions directly to Hidden Object dialogue.
v18.12.85: Fixed Hidden Object Minigame panel activation and hierarchy synchronization from dialogue triggers. Added robust Awake/OnEnable UI initialization and safe fallback handling.

v18.12.80: Fixed Alchemy Fishing horizontal beam reset — on each cast and attempt the indicator and spread variables (horizontalSpread, leftMovingBeam, rightMovingBeam) cleanly reset to the center (0.0 / 15px) instead of starting from the previous caught position.

v18.12.75: Fixed CS0618 warning for TMP_Text.enableWordWrapping. Added Smart Non-Overlapping Procedural Placement with collision avoidance and optional Custom Spawn Points (Transform / Vector2 coordinates) for each of the 3 rooms (Shop, House, Market).

v18.12.70: Fixed Hidden Object transition from Dialogue system with robust UI auto-hierarchy generation, 3 room cards (Shop, House, Market), 3 difficulty tiers (Easy, Normal, Hard), dynamic procedural fallback items/backgrounds, Zoom/Pan handling, hint system, victory rewards, and transition to Cauldron Defense.
